info.title: rusticdoc
info.description: Fills Office and PDF templates from JSON, converts documents with LibreOffice, and runs PDF operations. One multipart request does the whole job; webhooks deliver results asynchronously.

get.summary:
Liveness. With credentials configured, a caller without them sees the status
and nothing else.

Prometheus text format. With credentials configured it needs them too, unless
`RUSTICDOC_METRICS_PUBLIC` is set.

Readiness: the same as liveness today, kept separate so a warm-up can be
added without clients changing.

post.summary:
Converts uploads with LibreOffice and runs any post-processing fields.
Several files come back as a ZIP, or as one PDF with `merge=true`.

post.description:
Add `X-Rusticdoc-Webhook-Url` to get 204 at once and the result by webhook.
With `RUSTICDOC_WEBHOOK_SECRET` set, each caller's deliveries are signed with its
own key: `X-Rusticdoc-Signature` is `v1=` and the hex HMAC-SHA256 of
`<timestamp>.<event>.<request id>.<body>`, with the timestamp in
`X-Rusticdoc-Timestamp`, the event in `X-Rusticdoc-Event` and the request id in
`X-Request-Id`. The key is `HMAC-SHA256(secret, principal)`, or the secret itself
when the service requires no credentials; `rusticdoc webhook-secret` prints it.

post.summary:
Renders the template once per element of an array in the data and
returns the files in a ZIP, as Carbone's batch rendering does.
post.description:
`splitBy` names the array with a dotted path such as `items` or
`order.lines`. Each render sees the whole data with that array replaced
by the one element, plus `item` (the element) and `batch` (`index`,
`count`). `batchName` is a template for each file's name, default
`{{ batch.index }}`.

parameters.name: X-Rusticdoc-Webhook-Url
parameters.description: Deliver the ZIP here instead of in the response

200.description: A ZIP of the rendered files

204.description: Accepted; the result goes to the webhook

post.summary: Checks a template against sample data without converting anything.

BinaryFile.description:
A file in a response, for the API description: generated clients return
it as bytes.

ConvertForm.description:
The multipart form `/v1/convert` and `/forms/libreoffice/convert` accept.
Gotenberg's LibreOffice options (`landscape`, `nativePageRanges`,
`exportFormFields`, `singlePageSheets`, `password`, ...) and its
post-processing fields (`merge`, `splitMode`, `watermarkSource`,
`stampSource`, `rotateAngle`, `flatten`, `metadata`, `bookmarks`,
`embeds`, `facturxXml`, `userPassword`, ...) are accepted as well.

merge.description: Merge several inputs into one PDF instead of returning a ZIP.

files.description: The PDF first, then the files to attach.

ErrorBody.description: The JSON body of every error response.

message.description: What went wrong, for a person.

files.description: The PDF/A-3 invoice, then the Factur-X XML.

FieldSchema.description: One form field, as `/v1/pdf/forms/fields` lists them.

data.description: JSON object; a field named `customer.name` takes that path.

files.description: The PDF with form fields, and optionally tags in annotations.

flatten.description: Fix the values into the page content.

stripAnnotations.description: Remove the annotations that carried tags. Default true.

mounted.description: True when it came from the mounted fonts directory.

files.description: Two or more PDFs, merged in order.

metadata.description: JSON object of keys such as `Title`, `Author`, `Subject`, `Keywords`.

files.description: Two PDFs: the base, then the overlay laid over it page by page.
The PDF to work on. Several for merge.

changed.description: False when the directory has not changed, so no worker restarted.

RenderForm.description: The multipart form `/v1/render` accepts. Documented here; parsed by hand.

data.description: JSON object the template sees as its root.

metadata.description: JSON object of metadata fields for `metadata`.

outputFilename.description: File name of the result, without extension.

template.description:
The template. Text formats are filled today; Office formats are
converted as they are until phase 1.

pages.description: Page selection such as `1-3,5`; all when empty.

files.description: The PDF first, then one PNG or JPEG per placement.

page.description: 1-based page of each signature; repeat the field for several.

width.description: Width in points. Default the image's natural size.

x.description: Points from the page's left edge to the image's left edge.

y.description: Points from the page's bottom edge to the image's bottom edge.

splitSpan.description: For `pages`: ranges such as `1-3,5`. For `intervals`: pages per file.

splitUnify.description: For `pages`: one file holding every range instead of one per range.

diagnostics.description:
Every problem found: `severity`, `message`, and a `location` with
`part`, `place` and `snippet` where known.

engine.description: The engine that would handle it: `office`, `text` or `none`.

error.description: The first error, when `ok` is false.

ok.description: True when the template renders with the sample data.

template_hash.description: SHA-256 of the template, the cache key.

engines.description: Paths of the engines in use, or null when absent.
